title: Project Moonshot -- External Sagacity Producer + Commodity Search Substrate
objective: Three independent claims (design v0.3 s2, after the Astra review). H1 (Observatory): Phase 3 (the RSO) can correctly TYPE an unfamiliar external producer's evidence and its epistemic limits -- detectable violations and underpowered data recognized, and an EXECUTION_NOT_AUTHENTICATED ceiling preserved where evidence cannot distinguish an authentic run from a consistent pre-registration fabrication -- without relaxing its ruler to flatter the producer. H2 (Evolution): survival-only evolution in deterministic worlds can produce mechanisms whose dependence on retained hidden information survives the reactive-null family and the three causal interventions (channel-cut, destructive resample, information-preserving sham). H3 (Fusion): the integer neural primitive improves discovery under fair resource accounting (H3a) and is actually causally used (H3b). Any may resolve while the others do not; none rolls into a single verdict.
constraints: Survival is the pressure; sagacity is the measurement; reachability is the prerequisite; the ruler is the adversary (roles/Themis/design/MOONSHOT_DESIGN_v0.3.md).
No competence/sagacity measurement may enter reproductive fitness; sagacity is scored offline, air-gapped from selection.
A null is KILL only with the relevant reachability level (RC0/RC1/RC2) certified; otherwise UNDERPOWERED.

Themis may propose RSO amendments but must not be able to silently relax the ruler; the RSO cell owns whether evidence satisfies RSO contracts/predicates (DISTRIBUTED_WORK.md s1a; MOONSHOT_DESIGN_v0.3.md s15).
Internal fleet first; no extended cloud campaign authorized; the scout mechanism fires only once RC2 + the local gate exist, dollar cap fixed at launch (operator 2026-10-05).
Independent of EP-PHASE2B and EP-PHASE3; borrows substrate/machinery from both, takes scientific authority from neither.
Base-role doctrine and current MWO/CWO hard gates apply unchanged.
exit_conditions: Not set at the epic level (operator 2026-10-05). Each thread carries its own exit; NO_JUSTIFIED_FURTHER_WORK is legitimate. M1-M4 may each yield valuable negatives even if M5 never starts.
candidate_threads: TH-MOON-M5 -- Open-ended Ecology: world mutation, islands, migration, Red Queen; opens only after the Launchpad assay (M2) and reachability science (M3) are in hand
TH-MOON-M6 -- Scale Escalation: local CPU -> local GPU -> paid scout -> extended campaign; BEE substrate-transplant test; opens on earned evidence + operator cloud authorization
operator_decisions: 2026-10-05 Moonshot approved as a new Epic; Themis owns Epic/integration/producer/experiments (roles/Themis/prompts/2026-10-05_epic_approval_and_review/01_OPERATOR_REVIEW_verbatim.md).
2026-10-05 Substrate: wforge+Proteus for the Launchpad; BEE later as a substrate-transplant test.
2026-10-05 Fork: instrument-first. Fusion: neural-as-primitive first; neural-as-mutator auxiliary, outside selection authority.
2026-10-05 Cloud: no extended campaign authorized; scout mechanism authorized to build, fires only after RC2 + local gate, cap fixed at launch.
open: RSO contract amendment for SEMANTIC/PARTIAL reproducibility (only if a float GPU path is pursued), via the RSO cell's versioned process.
deferred: Open-ended ecology (M5) and extended cloud scale (M6) until earned.
scope: Prong 3 of the program: the hybrid neuro-symbolic engine as an adversarial external producer for Phase 3 and a commodity-scale sagacity search. Owns the producer, the offline S-meter, the fabric experiment, and the hostile RSO integration.
exclusions: Does not build or own the RSO (EP-PHASE3) or take Phase 2-B engine-hardening work (EP-PHASE2B).
Does not hold scientific authority over whether evidence satisfies RSO contracts/predicates (that is the RSO cell's).
